    // One level of the named scheme.
    SubdividedOnce(self: PolygonMesh3D, scheme: SubdivisionScheme): PolygonMesh3D
        => match (scheme) {
            CatmullClark => self.CatmullClarkSubdivided;
            Loop => self.ToTriangleMesh.LoopSubdivided.ToPolygonMesh;
            DooSabin => self.DooSabinSubdivided;
        };
